data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

侵权法 (Torts) - 精神痛苦索赔
正确答案：B
因为旁观者与受害者没有亲属关系。
核心法律规则：NIED

本题考查的是过失致人精神痛苦 (Negligent Infliction of Emotional Distress, NIED) 中的旁观者理论 (Bystander Theory)。

在大多数司法管辖区（以及MBE考试中），作为旁观者要想就目睹他人受伤而获得精神痛苦赔偿，必须同时满足以下三个条件：

  • 近亲关系：原告与受害者必须有紧密的家庭关系（如父母、子女、配偶）。
    (Closely related to the injured person)
  • 当场感知：原告必须在现场并当场目睹或感知到伤害的发生。
    (Present at the scene & contemporaneously perceived the event)
  • 严重痛苦：原告因此遭受了严重的情感困扰。
    (Suffered serious emotional distress)
本案分析

虽然旁观者目睹了事故（满足“当场感知”）并且遭受了严重痛苦（满足“严重痛苦”），但题目明确指出受害者是他“不认识” (whom the bystander did not know) 的人。

❌ 缺失要素：由于缺乏近亲关系，旁观者无法满足 NIED 的构成要件。

因此，选项 B 是正确的法律依据。

为什么其他选项是错的？
选项 C (危险招致救援) 错在哪里？

这是本题最大的干扰项。救援原则 (Rescue Doctrine) 确实规定“危险招致救援”，但这通常是为了让救援者能就其受到的身体伤害 (Physical Harm) 获得赔偿（即确立被告对救援者的注意义务）。

对于纯粹的精神痛苦，法院通常严格限制在“近亲”范围内，即使是救援者，如果只是目睹陌生人死亡而自己未受身体伤害，通常也不能通过救援原则绕过 NIED 的限制。

选项 D (危险区域) 错在哪里？

原告在“街对面”目睹事故，并未处于可能遭受物理撞击的危险区域 (Zone of Danger) 内。如果他在危险区域内（例如差点被车撞到），他就不需要证明与受害者的亲属关系，但他并不在。

💡 MBE 考试技巧
遇到 NIED (过失致人精神痛苦) 的题目，首先判断原告是“直接受害者”还是“旁观者”：
  1. 如果是直接受害者：看是否在“危险区域” (Zone of Danger) + 有身体症状 (Physical Manifestation)。
  2. 如果是旁观者：必须找“近亲关系” (Close Relative)。没有亲属关系 = 败诉（除非题目特别提及极少数例外，但在MBE中通常严格适用此规则）。

questions.question:
A patient received anesthesia while giving birth. Upon awakening from the anesthesia, she discovered a severe burn on the inner portion of her right knee.
The patient has brought a medical malpractice action in which she has joined all of the physicians and nurses who exercised control over her person, the delivery room, the medical procedures, and the equipment used during the period in which she was unconscious.
The defendants have jointly moved for summary judgment. The patient has produced affidavits that establish that the applicable professional standard of care was violated.
What would be the patient's best argument against the motion?

choices.a: At least one of the defendants had control over whatever agency or instrumentality caused the patient's injury.
choices.b: The defendants were acting in concert.
choices.c: The patient has produced affidavits that establish that the applicable professional standard of care was violated.
choices.d: The patient was in no way responsible for her injury.

data.questionStem:
Q83136

A patient received anesthesia while giving birth. Upon awakening from the anesthesia, she discovered a severe burn on the inner portion of her right knee.

The patient has brought a medical malpractice action in which she has joined all of the physicians and nurses who exercised control over her person, the delivery room, the medical procedures, and the equipment used during the period in which she was unconscious.

The defendants have jointly moved for summary judgment. The patient has produced affidavits that establish that the applicable professional standard of care was violated.

What would be the patient's best argument against the motion?

一名产妇在分娩时接受了麻醉。当她从麻醉中醒来时，发现自己右膝内侧有严重烧伤。

该患者提起了医疗事故诉讼，将所有在她昏迷期间对其人身、产房、医疗程序及所用设备行使控制权的医生和护士列为共同被告。

被告方共同提出了即决判决（summary judgment）的动议。该患者出具了宣誓书，证明相关的专业注意义务标准（professional standard of care）已被违反。

针对该动议，患者的最佳抗辩理由是什么？
options:
A. At least one of the defendants had control over whatever agency or instrumentality caused the patient's injury.
至少有一名被告对造成患者伤害的任何媒介或工具拥有控制权。

B. The defendants were acting in concert.
被告们是共同行动的。

C. The patient has produced affidavits that establish that the applicable professional standard of care was violated.
患者已出具宣誓书，证明相关的专业注意义务标准已被违反。

D. The patient was in no way responsible for her injury.
患者对自身的伤害没有任何责任。
data.explanation:
Res ipsa loquitur
(medical malpractice claims)


Applicability
  • Plaintiff suffered unusual injury while unconscious during medical treatment
  • At least one member of medical team had control over patient's body or instrumentality that caused injury
Effect
  • Creates inference that every member of medical team was negligent
  • Places burden on each member to establish that he/she was not negligent
Medical malpractice claims are based on negligence and generally require proof that the defendant violated a professional standard of care. But this can be difficult to prove when a complex procedure (eg, surgery) was performed by a team of medical professionals. In that case, the doctrine of res ipsa loquitur lets the fact finder infer that every member of the medical team was negligent when:
  • the patient suffered an unusual injury (ie, one that is usually caused by negligence) while unconscious and in the course of medical treatment and
  • at least one member of the medical team had control over the patient's body or instrumentalities that might have caused the patient's injury.


Here, the patient sued her medical team for a severe burn that she discovered upon awakening from anesthesia. And though the patient has affidavits showing that the professional standard of care was violated, she cannot identify which defendant was negligent (Choice C). But since at least one of the defendants had control over whatever instrumentality caused her unusual injury, the negligence of every defendant can be inferred. Therefore, this is the patient's best argument against the defendants' motion for summary judgment.

(Choice B) Tortfeasors who act in concert (ie, by agreement) and injure the plaintiff are jointly and severally liable for the entire injury. But here, there is no evidence that the defendants were acting in concert, and it is possible that a single defendant caused the patient's burn.

(Choice D) The patient was not responsible for her injury since she was anesthetized when it occurred. But her lack of responsibility does not prove that someone on her medical team was negligent.

Educational objective: Under the doctrine of res ipsa loquitur, it can be inferred that every member of a medical team was negligent when (1) the patient suffered an unusual injury while unconscious during medical treatment and (2) at least one member of the team had control over the patient's body or instrumentalities that might have caused the injury.

选项正确率统计：A选项 52%（正确选项），B选项 12%，C选项 23%，D选项 11%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

Res ipsa loquitur（事实自证原则）
（医疗事故索赔）


适用性
  • 原告在医疗过程中处于无意识状态时遭受了不寻常的伤害
  • 医疗团队中至少有一名成员对患者的身体或造成伤害的工具有控制权
效果
  • 可推定医疗团队的每位成员均存在过失
  • 将证明自己没有过失的举证责任转移给每位成员
医疗事故索赔基于过失，通常要求证明被告违反了专业注意义务标准。但是，当一个复杂的程序（如手术）由一个医疗专业团队执行时，这一点可能很难证明。在这种情况下，事实自证原则（res ipsa loquitur）允许事实认定者推定医疗团队的每位成员均存在过失，前提是：
  • 患者在医疗过程中处于无意识状态时，遭受了不寻常的伤害（即通常由过失造成的伤害）并且
  • 医疗团队中至少有一名成员对可能造成患者伤害的患者身体或工具拥有控制权。


在本案中，患者因从麻醉中醒来后发现的严重烧伤而起诉其医疗团队。尽管患者有宣誓书证明专业注意义务标准已被违反，但她无法确定具体是哪位被告存在过失（选项 C）。但由于至少有一名被告对造成她不寻常伤害的任何工具拥有控制权，因此可以推定每位被告都存在过失。因此，这是患者反对被告方即决判决（summary judgment）动议的最佳抗辩理由。

（选项 B）共同行动（即通过协议）并对原告造成伤害的侵权行为人，应对全部损害承担连带责任。但在本案中，没有证据表明被告们是共同行动的，患者的烧伤有可能是由单个被告造成的。

（选项 D）患者对自己的伤害没有责任，因为伤害发生时她正处于麻醉状态。但她没有责任并不能证明其医疗团队中有人存在过失。

教学目的：根据事实自证原则（res ipsa loquitur），当（1）患者在医疗过程中处于无意识状态时遭受了不寻常的伤害，并且（2）医疗团队中至少有一名成员对可能造成伤害的患者身体或工具有控制权时，可以推定该医疗团队的每位成员均存在过失。

References

Restatement (Second) of Torts § 328D (Am. Law Inst. 1965) (explaining when a defendant's negligence can be inferred based on the type of accident that injured the plaintiff).

Ybarra v. Spangard, 25 Cal. 2d 486, 494 (1944) (holding that all defendants who control an unconscious patient's body while the patient suffers unusual injuries are subject to an inference of negligence).

MBE 考点解析

Negligence & Res Ipsa Loquitur
核心考点：事实自证原则
Res Ipsa Loquitur

字面意思是“事情本身说明了一切”。在侵权法中，它允许陪审团仅凭事故发生的事实就推断被告存在过失（Negligence）。

📚 经典判例：Ybarra v. Spangard (1944)

本题几乎是该案的翻版。在该案中，一名患者在阑尾切除手术后醒来，发现肩膀受伤。由于他在手术期间处于昏迷状态，无法指出具体是哪位医生或护士造成了伤害。

法院裁决： 当无意识的患者在医疗团队的护理下受到不寻常的伤害时，所有对患者行使控制权的被告都有责任证明自己没有过失。

逻辑推演图解

1. 现状 (Status)
患者昏迷 (Unconscious)，无法指认具体加害人。
2. 困境 (Dilemma)
通常原告需证明“特定被告”有“特定过失”。如果无法指认，通常会败诉。
3. 破局 (Solution) - 选项 A
证明被告团队对造成伤害的工具/环境拥有控制权 (Control)。
4. 结果 (Result)
举证责任倒置 (Burden shifts)。所有被告必须自证清白，否则承担连带责任。

✅ 最佳论点解析 (选项 A)

"At least one of the defendants had control..."

这是应用 Res Ipsa Loquitur 在多名被告（医疗团队）情况下的关键要素。

虽然患者已经证明了“标准被违反”（选项C），但如果她不能将这种违反与被告联系起来，她仍然会输。选项 A 建立了这种联系：因为他们控制了局面，所以过失一定来自他们中的某一个或几个。这迫使被告方必须站出来解释“不是我做的”，否则即决判决（Summary Judgment）将被驳回。

❌ 为什么其他选项不够好？

  • 选项 B (Acting in concert): 这是一个陷阱。共同行动通常指合谋或协同作案。本案中医生护士只是在同一手术室工作，并没有证据表明他们“合谋”造成伤害。
  • 选项 C (Standard violated): 这是一个必要条件，但不是充分论点。证明“有人犯错了”还不够，必须证明“是这群被告控制了局面”，才能让这群人负责。
  • 选项 D (No contributory negligence): 证明原告无过失（Contributory Negligence）只是排除了被告的抗辩理由，并不能直接证明被告有过失。
💡 MBE 考试技巧 看到 “手术/昏迷 (Unconscious)” + “身体其他部位受伤 (Unrelated Injury)” + “无法确定具体是谁 (Unknown Tortfeasor)” 的组合时，立即联想 Res Ipsa Loquitur 和 Ybarra v. Spangard 规则。

关键在于：控制权 (Control) 将责任锁定在被告群体身上。

questions.question:
A shopper was riding on an escalator in a department store when the escalator stopped abruptly. The shopper lost her balance and fell down the escalator steps, sustaining injuries. Although the escalator had been regularly maintained by an independent contractor, the store's obligation to provide safe conditions for its invitees was nondelegable. The shopper has brought an action against the store for damages, and the above facts are the only facts in evidence.
The store has moved for a directed verdict.
Should the court grant the motion?

choices.a: No, because the finder of fact could infer that the escalator malfunction was due to negligence.
choices.b: No, because the store is strictly liable for the shopper's injuries.
choices.c: Yes, because an independent contractor maintained the escalator.
choices.d: Yes, because the shopper has not produced evidence of negligence.

data.questionStem:
Q83095

A shopper was riding on an escalator in a department store when the escalator stopped abruptly. The shopper lost her balance and fell down the escalator steps, sustaining injuries. Although the escalator had been regularly maintained by an independent contractor, the store's obligation to provide safe conditions for its invitees was nondelegable. The shopper has brought an action against the store for damages, and the above facts are the only facts in evidence.

The store has moved for a directed verdict.

Should the court grant the motion?

一名购物者在百货商店乘坐自动扶梯时，扶梯突然停止。该购物者失去平衡，从扶梯台阶上摔下并受伤。尽管该自动扶梯由一名独立承包商定期维护，但商店为其受邀人提供安全环境的义务是不可转委托的。该购物者已向商店提起损害赔偿之诉，上述事实是唯一的呈堂证据。

商店已申请作出裁决指示。

法院是否应批准该申请？
options:
A. No, because the finder of fact could infer that the escalator malfunction was due to negligence.
不应批准，因为事实审理者可以推断自动扶梯故障是由过失所致。

B. No, because the store is strictly liable for the shopper's injuries.
不应批准，因为商店对购物者的伤害承担严格责任。

C. Yes, because an independent contractor maintained the escalator.
应批准，因为自动扶梯由一名独立承包商维护。

D. Yes, because the shopper has not produced evidence of negligence.
应批准，因为购物者未能提供过失的证据。
data.explanation:
A court should grant a defendant's motion for a directed verdict if the plaintiff fails to present legally sufficient evidence to support any theory of recovery. A plaintiff can recover for negligence under theories of:

  • direct liability (for the defendant's own conduct) - requires proof that the defendant's failure to exercise reasonable care caused the plaintiff harm or
  • vicarious liability (for an independent contractor's conduct) - requires proof that a contractor's work involved a nondelegable duty owed by the defendant - a duty that cannot be assigned to a third party to avoid liability - and the contractor's breach of that duty (ie, negligence) caused the plaintiff harm.


Since businesses have a duty to provide safe conditions for their invitees (eg, customers), the store could be directly liable if the shopper can show that her injuries were caused by the store's negligence. And since that duty is nondelegable, the store could also be vicariously liable for its independent contractor's negligence (Choice C). And though there is no direct evidence of the store's or the contractor's negligence, the doctrine of res ipsa loquitur allows negligence to be inferred from circumstantial evidence when:

  • the type of accident that caused the plaintiff's harm would not ordinarily occur absent negligence by someone in the defendant's (or the contractor's) position and
  • the evidence tends to eliminate other potential causes of that harm.


Here, an escalator would not ordinarily malfunction in the absence of negligence by someone operating or maintaining the escalator, and there is no evidence of other possible causes of the shopper's harm. The fact finder could therefore infer that the malfunction was due to either the store's or the contractor's negligence and that this negligence caused the shopper's injuries (Choice D). As a result, the evidence is legally sufficient to support the shopper's recovery under either theory, and the court should deny the store's motion for a directed verdict.

(Choice B) Strict liability applies to strict products liability, certain animals, and abnormally dangerous activities. But here, the shopper was not harmed by a product sold by the store (no strict products liability), an animal, or an abnormally dangerous activity.

Educational objective: A defendant can be (1) directly liable for his/her own negligence or (2) vicariously liable for an independent contractor's negligence if the contractor's work involved a nondelegable duty owed by the defendant - eg, a business's duty to maintain safe premises for its invitees.



选项正确率统计：A选项 72%（正确选项），B选项 14%，C选项 1%，D选项 11%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

如果原告未能提供法律上充分的证据来支持任何索赔理论，法院应批准被告提出的裁决指示申请。原告可以根据以下理论因过失获得赔偿：

  • 直接责任（针对被告自身的行为）- 要求证明被告未能尽到合理注意义务对原告造成了损害或
  • 替代责任（针对独立承包商的行为）- 要求证明承包商的工作涉及被告所负有的不可转委托的义务——即一项为规避责任而不能转让给第三方的义务——并且承包商违反该义务（即过失）对原告造成了损害。


由于商家对其受邀人（如顾客）负有提供安全环境的义务，如果购物者能证明其伤害是由商店的过失造成的，商店可能要承担直接责任。又由于该义务是不可转委托的，商店也可能要因其独立承包商的过失而承担替代责任（选项C）。尽管没有直接证据证明商店或承包商存在过失，但 res ipsa loquitur 原则允许在以下情况下通过间接证据推断过失：

  • 若非处于被告（或承包商）地位的某人存在过失，造成原告伤害的此类事故通常不会发生并且
  • 证据倾向于排除造成该伤害的其他潜在原因。


在本案中，如果没有操作或维护自动扶梯的人存在过失，自动扶梯通常不会发生故障，并且没有证据表明购物者的伤害有其他可能的原因。因此，事实审理者可以推断，故障是由于商店或承包商的过失所致，并且该过失导致了购物者的伤害（选项D）。因此，证据在法律上足以支持购物者根据任一理论获得赔偿，法院应驳回商店的裁决指示申请。

（选项B）严格责任适用于严格产品责任、特定动物和异常危险活动。但在本案中，购物者并非因商店销售的产品（无严格产品责任）、动物或异常危险活动而受到伤害。

教学目标：如果独立承包商的工作涉及被告所负有的不可转委托的义务——例如，商家为其受邀人维护安全经营场所的义务，那么被告可能（1）为其自身的过失承担直接责任，或（2）为独立承包商的过失承担替代责任。

References

  • Fed. R. Civ. P. 50(a) (judgment as a matter of law).
  • Restatement (Third) of Torts: Liab. for Physical & Emotional Harm § 6 (Am. Law Inst. 2010) (direct liability for negligence).
  • Restatement (Third) of Torts: Liab. for Physical & Emotional Harm § 62 (Am. Law Inst. 2012) (vicarious liability for independent contractor's negligence).
  • Restatement (Third) of Torts: Liab. for Physical & Emotional Harm § 17 (Am. Law Inst. 2010) (res ipsa loquitur).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

侵权法 (Torts) - 过失 (Negligence)
正确答案：A

不应批准裁决指示，因为事实审理者（Finder of Fact）可以推断自动扶梯的故障是由过失所致。

本题的核心考点在于如何在没有直接证据的情况下证明过失，以及不可转委托义务的适用。

核心考点：事实自证原则

虽然原告没有直接证据（Direct Evidence）证明商店具体哪里做错了，但本案适用 Res Ipsa Loquitur（事实自证/事情本身说明了一切）原则。

该原则允许陪审团从环境证据中推断过失的存在，只要满足以下条件：

  • 事故性质：此类事故（扶梯突然急停）在没有过失的情况下通常不会发生。
  • 控制权：致害工具（扶梯）处于被告的控制之下（或被告对其负有责任）。

因此，即使没有具体证据，案件也足以提交给陪审团，法院不能直接判被告胜诉（Directed Verdict）。

核心考点：不可转委托义务

被告试图辩称扶梯是由“独立承包商” (Independent Contractor) 维护的。通常，雇主不对独立承包商的过失负责。

但是，作为向公众开放的商店，其为受邀人（Invitees）提供安全场所的义务是不可转委托的 (Non-delegable Duty)。

这意味着：商店不能通过雇佣承包商来推卸责任。如果承包商有过失，商店仍需负责。

为什么其他选项是错的？

  • 选项 B (Strict Liability)：错误。场所责任（Premises Liability）通常基于过失（Negligence），而非严格责任。只有在极少数情况（如极度危险活动）下才适用严格责任。
  • 选项 C (Independent Contractor)：错误。如上所述，因为该安全义务是“不可转委托”的，所以承包商维护这一事实不能免除商店的责任。
  • 选项 D (No Evidence)：错误。虽然没有“直接”证据，但 Res Ipsa Loquitur 提供了“推断”证据，这在法律上足以对抗裁决指示动议。
🎓 MBE 考试技巧
当你在题目中看到： 1. 发生了一个奇怪的事故（如电梯坠落、扶梯急停、手术刀留在体内）； 2. 题目强调“这是唯一的证据”或“没有直接证据”； 3. 被告申请“裁决指示” (Directed Verdict)；

请立即联想 Res Ipsa Loquitur。它的作用就是帮助原告在缺乏直接证据时，让案件能够进入陪审团审理阶段，从而避免被法官直接驳回。

questions.question:
Under the Federal Tort Claims Act, with certain exceptions not relevant here, the federal government is liable only for negligence. A federally owned and operated nuclear reactor emitted substantial quantities of radioactive matter that settled on a nearby dairy farm, killing the dairy herd and contaminating the soil. At the trial of an action brought against the federal government by the farm's owner, the trier of fact found the following: (1) the nuclear plant had a sound design, but a valve made by an engineering company had malfunctioned and allowed the radioactive matter to escape; (2) the engineering company was universally regarded as a quality manufacturer of components for nuclear plants; and (3) there was no way the federal government could have anticipated or prevented the emission of the radioactive matter.
If there is no other applicable statute, for which party should the court enter judgment?

choices.a: The farm owner, on the ground that one who allows dangerous material to escape to the property of another is liable for the damage done.
choices.b: The farm owner, on the ground that the doctrine of res ipsa loquitur applies.
choices.c: The government, on the ground that a case under the Federal Tort Claims Act has not been proved.
choices.d: The government, on the ground that the engineering company is the proximate cause of the farm owner's damage.

data.questionStem:
Q83121

Under the Federal Tort Claims Act, with certain exceptions not relevant here, the federal government is liable only for negligence. A federally owned and operated nuclear reactor emitted substantial quantities of radioactive matter that settled on a nearby dairy farm, killing the dairy herd and contaminating the soil. At the trial of an action brought against the federal government by the farm's owner, the trier of fact found the following: (1) the nuclear plant had a sound design, but a valve made by an engineering company had malfunctioned and allowed the radioactive matter to escape; (2) the engineering company was universally regarded as a quality manufacturer of components for nuclear plants; and (3) there was no way the federal government could have anticipated or prevented the emission of the radioactive matter.

If there is no other applicable statute, for which party should the court enter judgment?

根据《Federal Tort Claims Act》，除与本案无关的某些例外情况外，联邦政府仅对过失行为承担责任。一个联邦政府所有并运营的核反应堆泄漏了大量的放射性物质，这些物质沉降在附近的一个奶牛场，导致牛群死亡，土壤受到污染。在农场主对联邦政府提起的诉讼审判中，事实审理者查明了以下事实：（1）该核电站设计完善，但一家工程公司制造的阀门发生故障，导致放射性物质泄漏；（2）该工程公司被公认为是核电站部件的优质制造商；（3）联邦政府无法预见或阻止此次放射性物质的泄漏。

如果没有其他适用的法规，法院应为哪一方当事人作出判决？
options:
A. The farm owner, on the ground that one who allows dangerous material to escape to the property of another is liable for the damage done.
农场主，理由是，任何允许危险物质泄漏至他人财产的人，均应对造成的损害承担责任。

B. The farm owner, on the ground that the doctrine of res ipsa loquitur applies.
农场主，理由是，res ipsa loquitur原则在此适用。

C. The government, on the ground that a case under the Federal Tort Claims Act has not been proved.
政府，理由是，原告未能证明其主张符合《Federal Tort Claims Act》的要求。

D. The government, on the ground that the engineering company is the proximate cause of the farm owner's damage.
政府，理由是，工程公司是造成农场主损害的近因。
data.explanation:
Elements of negligence


Dutydefendant owed duty of reasonable care because his/her conduct created foreseeable risk of harm to others
Breachdefendant breached duty by failing to use reasonable care
Causationdefendant's breach actually & proximately caused plaintiff's harm
Damagesplaintiff suffered physical harm (ie, bodily injury or property damage)
Land possessors owe a duty of reasonable care when they know or should know that an activity on the land poses an unreasonable risk of physical harm (ie, bodily harm or property damage) to others. A land possessor who breaches this duty and causes the plaintiff physical harm is liable for negligence.

Here, the federally owned and operated nuclear reactor emitted radioactive matter that killed the farm owner's dairy herd and contaminated his soil. But since the federal government could not have anticipated the emission, it could not have known that the reactor posed an unreasonable risk of harm. Therefore, the court should enter judgment for the government on the ground that negligence cannot be proved.

(Choice A) Strict liability - ie, liability without proof of fault - is imposed for harm caused by abnormally dangerous activities. Operating a nuclear reactor may be abnormally dangerous. But under the Federal Tort Claims Act, the federal government is liable only for negligence.

(Choice B) The doctrine of res ipsa loquitur would not permit an inference of negligence by the federal government here. That is because the nuclear reactor is complex machinery that could have malfunctioned for reasons other than negligence by the federal government - eg, negligence by the engineering company that made its parts.

(Choice D) More than one defendant may be a proximate cause of the plaintiff's harm. Therefore, the fact that the engineering company proximately caused the farm owner's damage would not eliminate the federal government's liability had that damage also been a foreseeable consequence of the government's conduct.

Educational objective: Land possessors have a duty of reasonable care when they know or should know that an activity on the land poses an unreasonable risk of physical harm to others (ie, when such a risk is foreseeable).

选项正确率统计：A选项 19%，B选项 19%，C选项 44%（正确选项），D选项 17%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

过失的构成要件


义务 (Duty)被告因其行为对他人造成了可预见的损害风险，因此负有合理注意义务
违反 (Breach)被告未能尽到合理注意义务，从而违反了该义务
因果关系 (Causation)被告违反义务的行为是原告损害的实际原因与近因
损害赔偿 (Damages)原告遭受了有形损害（即人身伤害或财产损害）
土地占有人在其知道或理应知道土地上的活动对他人构成不合理的有形损害风险（即人身伤害或财产损害）时，负有合理注意义务。违反此义务并对原告造成有形损害的土地占有人，应承担过失责任。

在本案中，联邦政府所有并运营的核反应堆泄漏了放射性物质，导致农场主的牛群死亡，土壤受到污染。但由于联邦政府无法预见此次泄漏，因此其无法知道该反应堆构成了不合理的损害风险。因此，法院应以无法证明过失为由，作出对政府有利的判决。

（选项 A）严格责任——即无需证明过错的责任——适用于由异常危险活动造成的损害。运营核反应堆可能属于异常危险活动。但根据《Federal Tort Claims Act》，联邦政府仅对过失行为承担责任。

（选项 B）res ipsa loquitur原则在本案中不允许推定联邦政府存在过失。这是因为核反应堆是复杂的机械设备，其故障原因可能并非联邦政府的过失——例如，可能是制造其部件的工程公司的过失。

（选项 D）原告的损害可能有一个以上的近因。因此，即使工程公司是造成农场主损害的近因，如果该损害同时也是政府行为的可预见后果，这一事实也不能免除联邦政府的责任。

教学目标：土地占有人在知道或理应知道其土地上的活动对他人构成不合理的有形损害风险时（即当该风险是可预见时），负有合理注意义务。

References

Restatement (Second) of Torts § 371 (Am. Law Inst. 1965) (explaining that land possessors are subject to liability for harm caused by activities on their land that pose an unreasonable risk of harm to others).

MBE 考题解析

Federal Tort Claims Act & Negligence
⚖️ 核心法律规则

根据《联邦侵权索赔法》(Federal Tort Claims Act, FTCA)，联邦政府仅对过失 (Negligence) 承担责任，而不对严格责任 (Strict Liability) 承担责任。

案情关键点分析

本题的胜负关键在于题目中给出的事实认定（Findings of Fact）：

  • 设计完善：核电站设计没有问题。
  • 第三方故障：是工程公司的阀门出了问题。
  • 无法预见/阻止：这是最关键的一点。事实认定指出政府 "could not have anticipated or prevented" 泄漏。
正确答案 C

政府胜诉，因为未能证明符合 FTCA 的要求。

逻辑推演：

  1. 题目明确指出 FTCA 下政府只对 Negligence 负责。
  2. 过失 (Negligence) 的核心要素是违反了合理注意义务 (Breach of Duty)。
  3. 既然事实认定政府“无法预见或阻止”该事故，说明政府已经尽到了合理的注意义务，不存在过失。
  4. 没有过失，FTCA 下的责任就不成立。
为什么其他选项是错的？
选项 A 错误

理由：严格责任 (Strict Liability)

选项 A 描述的是从事异常危险活动（如核电站）的严格责任原则。虽然在普通法下核泄漏通常适用严格责任，但本题受限于 FTCA，该法案明确排除了联邦政府的严格责任。

选项 B 错误

理由：事实自证 (Res Ipsa Loquitur)

Res Ipsa Loquitur 是一种允许陪审团推断过失的证据规则。但在本案中，事实审理者（Trier of Fact）已经明确查明了事故的具体原因（第三方阀门故障）且认定政府无法阻止。当具体事实证明被告没有过失时，不能再利用该原则强行推断过失。

选项 D 错误

理由：近因 (Proximate Cause)

虽然工程公司是近因，但这并不是政府胜诉的法律依据。如果政府也存在过失（例如疏于检查），即使工程公司是主要原因，政府仍可能承担连带责任。政府胜诉的根本原因是因为政府没有过失，而不是因为存在另一个责任方。

💡 MBE 考试技巧

1. 仔细阅读限定条件： 题目第一句就给出了法律标准（"liable only for negligence"）。这是解题的“尚方宝剑”，直接排除了所有基于严格责任的选项。

2. 尊重事实认定： 题目中 "Findings of Fact" 是不可辩驳的前提。如果题目说“无法预见”，那么在法律分析时就不能假设“应该预见”。

A mother purchased an expensive television from an appliance store for her adult son. Two years after the purchase, a fire started in the son's living room in the middle of the night. The fire department concluded that the fire had started in the television. No other facts are known.
The son sued the appliance store for negligence. The store has moved for summary judgment.
Should the court grant the store's motion?

choices.a: No, because televisions do not catch fire in the absence of negligence.
choices.b: No, because the store sold the television.
choices.c: Yes, because the son is not in privity with the store.
choices.d: Yes, because there is no evidence of negligence on the part of the store.

data.questionStem:
Q83133

A mother purchased an expensive television from an appliance store for her adult son. Two years after the purchase, a fire started in the son's living room in the middle of the night. The fire department concluded that the fire had started in the television. No other facts are known.

The son sued the appliance store for negligence. The store has moved for summary judgment.

Should the court grant the store's motion?

一位母亲为她的成年儿子从一家电器商店购买了一台昂贵的电视。购买两年后，一天午夜，儿子家的客厅起火。消防部门的结论是，火灾始于电视机。没有其他已知事实。

儿子以过失为由起诉了该电器商店。该商店已提出即决判决的动议。

法院是否应批准该商店的动议？
options:
A. No, because televisions do not catch fire in the absence of negligence.
不应批准，因为在没有过失的情况下，电视机不会起火。

B. No, because the store sold the television.
不应批准，因为该商店出售了这台电视机。

C. Yes, because the son is not in privity with the store.
应批准，因为儿子与该商店没有合同相对性关系。

D. Yes, because there is no evidence of negligence on the part of the store.
应批准，因为没有证据表明该商店存在过失。
data.explanation:
Products liability claims


ClaimsRequired elements
Strict products liability
  • Commercial seller produced or sold defective product
  • Product caused plaintiff harm
Negligence
  • Seller (commercial or noncommercial) failed to use reasonable care in producing or inspecting defective product
  • Product caused plaintiff harm
Intentional tort
  • Seller (commercial or noncommercial) purposefully or knowingly produced or sold defective product
  • Product caused plaintiff harm
Misrepresentation†
  • Commercial seller misrepresented material fact about product
  • Consumer justifiably relied on misrepresentation when purchasing product
  • Product caused plaintiff harm
Warranty (Merchantability - implied)
  • Commercial seller warranted product is generally acceptable & reasonably fit for its ordinary purpose
Warranty (Fitness for particular purpose - implied)
  • Seller (commercial or noncommercial) warranted product is fit for particular purpose
  • Purchaser relied on seller's judgment or skill to purchase product
Warranty (Express)
  • Seller (commercial or noncommercial) made affirmation of fact or promise that is part of basis of bargain
†Commercial sellers are strictly liable for the misrepresentations they make regarding their products - regardless of whether those products are defective.

To prevail on a products liability claim based on negligence, the plaintiff generally must prove that the defendant's failure to use reasonable care caused the plaintiff harm. But in the absence of direct evidence of negligence, the doctrine of res ipsa loquitur allows the defendant's negligence to be inferred when:
  • the plaintiff suffered a type of harm that is usually caused by negligence of someone in the defendant's position and
  • the evidence tends to eliminate other potential causes of that harm.

If the plaintiff fails to provide sufficient evidence to support such an inference of negligence (ie, no reasonable jury could find in the plaintiff's favor), the court should grant the defendant's motion for summary judgment.

Here, the fire in the son's living room started in his television, which had been purchased from an appliance store two years earlier. But there is no direct evidence of the store's negligence. And even if televisions do not usually catch fire in the absence of a store's negligence, the evidence does not eliminate other potential causes of the fire - eg, manufacturing defect, improper repair (Choice A). Therefore, there is insufficient evidence to infer that the store was negligent, and the court should grant the store's motion for summary judgment.

(Choice B) Commercial sellers (ie, manufacturers, wholesalers, and retailers) are strictly liable for harm caused by defective products that they sell. But here, the son sued the store for negligence - not strict products liability.

(Choice C) Negligence does not require the plaintiff to be in privity (ie, in a contractual relationship) with the defendant. Instead, any foreseeable plaintiff can recover for injuries caused by the defendant's negligence.

Educational objective: Under the doctrine of res ipsa loquitur, the defendant's negligence can be inferred when (1) the plaintiff suffered a type of harm that is usually caused by negligence of someone in the defendant's position and (2) the evidence tends to eliminate other potential causes of that harm.

选项正确率统计：A选项 29%，B选项 20%，C选项 3%，D选项 47%（正确选项）
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

产品责任索赔


索赔类型必要要件
严格产品责任 (Strict products liability)
  • 商业销售者生产或销售了有缺陷的产品
  • 产品对原告造成了损害
过失 (Negligence)
  • 销售者（商业或非商业）在生产或检验有缺陷产品时未能尽到合理注意义务
  • 产品对原告造成了损害
故意侵权行为 (Intentional tort)
  • 销售者（商业或非商业）故意或明知地生产或销售了有缺陷的产品
  • 产品对原告造成了损害
不实陈述 (Misrepresentation)†
  • 商业销售者对产品的重大事实作出了不实陈述
  • 消费者在购买产品时正当地信赖了该不实陈述
  • 产品对原告造成了损害
保证（适销性——默示）(Warranty (Merchantability - implied))
  • 商业销售者保证产品是普遍可接受的，并合理地适合其通常用途
保证（特定用途适用性——默示）(Warranty (Fitness for particular purpose - implied))
  • 销售者（商业或非商业）保证产品适合特定用途
  • 购买者依赖销售者的判断或技能来购买产品
保证（明示）(Warranty (Express))
  • 销售者（商业或非商业）作出的事实断言或承诺，构成了交易基础的一部分
†商业销售者对其产品所作的不实陈述承担严格责任——无论该产品是否有缺陷。

要在基于过失 (negligence) 的产品责任索赔中胜诉，原告通常必须证明被告未能尽到合理注意义务从而对原告造成了损害。但在缺乏过失的直接证据时，事实自证原则 (res ipsa loquitur) 允许在以下情况下推断被告存在过失：
  • 原告遭受的损害类型通常是由处于被告地位之人的过失所致，并且
  • 证据倾向于排除造成该损害的其他潜在原因。

如果原告未能提供足够证据来支持此类过失的推断（即，没有一个理性的陪审团会作出有利于原告的裁决），法院应批准被告的即决判决动议。

在本案中，儿子客厅的火灾始于他的电视机，该电视机是两年前从一家电器商店购买的。但没有直接证据表明该商店存在过失。而且，即使在商店没有过失的情况下电视机通常不会起火，证据也未能排除火灾的其他潜在原因——例如，制造缺陷、不当维修 (选项 A)。因此，没有足够证据来推断该商店存在过失，法院应批准该商店的即决判决动议。

(选项 B) 商业销售者（即制造商、批发商和零售商）对他们销售的有缺陷产品所造成的损害承担严格责任。但在本案中，儿子是以过失为由起诉该商店——而非以严格产品责任为由。

(选项 C) 过失责任不要求原告与被告之间存在合同相对性关系 (privity)（即合同关系）。相反，任何可预见的原告都可以因被告的过失造成的损害获得赔偿。

教学目标：根据事实自证原则 (res ipsa loquitur)，当 (1) 原告遭受的损害类型通常是由处于被告地位之人的过失所致，并且 (2) 证据倾向于排除造成该损害的其他潜在原因时，可以推断被告存在过失。

References

Restatement (Second) of Torts § 328D (Am. Law Inst. 1965) (explaining when a defendant's negligence can be inferred based on the type of accident that injured the plaintiff).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析：产品责任中的过失

Torts (侵权法) Negligence (过失) Products Liability (产品责任)
正确答案：D
法院应批准即决判决 (Summary Judgment)，因为原告没有提供证据证明商店存在过失。

1. 核心考点：诉因的区别

这道题最大的陷阱在于混淆了严格产品责任 (Strict Products Liability) 和 过失 (Negligence)。

诉因 (Cause of Action) 针对零售商 (Retailer) 的证明责任
严格责任
(Strict Liability)		 只需证明零售商处于商业分销链中，且产品售出时有缺陷。无需证明过失。
过失
(Negligence)		 必须证明零售商违反了注意义务 (Breach of Duty)。例如：未能发现明显的缺陷。

题目明确指出儿子起诉的理由是“Negligence”。因此，仅仅证明“电视机是商店卖的”且“电视机起火了”是不够的。

2. 法律推理与逻辑

为什么商店没有过失？

在过失侵权中，原告必须证明被告的行为低于合理人的标准。对于销售品牌电器的零售商而言：

  • 义务范围：零售商通常没有义务打开制造商的密封包装去检查复杂的电子元件。
  • 缺乏证据：题目指出“没有其他已知事实”。没有证据表明商店在仓储、运输或销售过程中损坏了电视，也没有证据表明商店知道该电视有缺陷。

关于“事实自证” (Res Ipsa Loquitur)

原告可能会试图利用 Res Ipsa Loquitur 原则（事情本身说明了过失）来推定过失，但这在本案中行不通：

  1. 控制权 (Control)：电视机已经离开商店两年了。商店不再对该产品拥有“排他性控制” (Exclusive Control)。
  2. 其他原因：火灾可能是由制造缺陷（制造商的责任）、用户使用不当、电路老化或外部电源浪涌引起的，这些都不能直接推导出零售商的过失。

3. 选项解析

  • 选项 A (No, because televisions...)
    错误。 这试图套用 Res Ipsa Loquitur。虽然电视自燃通常意味着有问题，但这更指向制造缺陷（制造商的问题），而不能直接证明仅仅负责销售的商店有过失。
  • 选项 B (No, because the store sold...)
    错误。 这是严格责任的逻辑。如果是 Strict Liability 诉讼，只要商店处于销售链中就要负责。但在 Negligence 诉讼中，仅仅“销售”并不构成过失。
  • 选项 C (Yes, because... privity)
    错误。 这是一个过时的法律概念。自著名的 MacPherson v. Buick 判例以来，过失侵权诉讼不再要求原告与被告之间存在合同相对性 (Privity)。任何可预见的受害者（如买家的家人）都可以起诉。
  • 选项 D (Yes, because no evidence...)
    正确。 在过失诉讼中，原告承担举证责任。既然没有任何证据显示商店在注意义务上有疏忽（Breach），原告无法建立表面证据确凿的案件 (Prima Facie Case)，因此法院应批准即决判决。
💡 考试技巧：
在做 MBE 产品责任题时，第一步永远是圈出诉讼理论 (Theory of Liability)。 如果是 Negligence，必须找被告“做错了什么”；如果是 Strict Liability，只需找“产品缺陷”。不要用严格责任的规则去解过失的题目！

questions.question:
A homeowner and a group of his friends are fanatical basketball fans who regularly meet at each other's homes to watch basketball games on television. Some of the group are fans of team A, and others are fans of team B. When the group has watched televised games between these two teams, fights sometimes have broken out among the group. Despite this fact, the homeowner invited the group to his home to watch a championship game between teams A and B.
During the game, the homeowner's guests became rowdy and antagonistic. Fearing that they would begin to fight and that a fight would damage his possessions, the homeowner asked his guests to leave. They refused to go and soon began to fight. The homeowner called the police, and an officer was sent to the homeowner's home. The officer sustained a broken nose in his efforts to stop the fighting.
The officer brought an action against the homeowner alleging that he was negligent in inviting the group to his house to watch this championship game. The homeowner has moved to dismiss the complaint.
What is the best argument in support of this motion?

choices.a: A police officer is not entitled to a recovery based upon the negligent conduct that created the need for the officer's professional intervention.
choices.b: A rescuer injured while attempting to avert a danger cannot recover damages from the endangered person.
choices.c: As a matter of law, the homeowner's conduct was not the proximate cause of the police officer's injury.
choices.d: The homeowner did not owe the police officer a duty to use reasonable care, because the officer was a mere licensee on the homeowner's property.

Q83109

A homeowner and a group of his friends are fanatical basketball fans who regularly meet at each other's homes to watch basketball games on television. Some of the group are fans of team A, and others are fans of team B. When the group has watched televised games between these two teams, fights sometimes have broken out among the group. Despite this fact, the homeowner invited the group to his home to watch a championship game between teams A and B.

During the game, the homeowner's guests became rowdy and antagonistic. Fearing that they would begin to fight and that a fight would damage his possessions, the homeowner asked his guests to leave. They refused to go and soon began to fight. The homeowner called the police, and an officer was sent to the homeowner's home. The officer sustained a broken nose in his efforts to stop the fighting.

The officer brought an action against the homeowner alleging that he was negligent in inviting the group to his house to watch this championship game. The homeowner has moved to dismiss the complaint.

What is the best argument in support of this motion?

一位房主和他的一群朋友是狂热的篮球迷，他们定期在彼此家中聚会，观看电视上的篮球比赛。这群人中有些是A队的球迷，另一些是B队的球迷。当这群人观看这两支球队之间的电视转播比赛时，他们之间有时会爆发斗殴。尽管如此，该房主还是邀请这群人到他家观看A队和B队之间的一场冠军赛。

比赛期间，房主的客人们变得吵闹和敌对。由于担心他们会开始打架，并且打斗会损坏他的财物，房主请他的客人们离开。他们拒绝离开，并很快开始打斗。房主报了警，一名警官被派往房主家中。该警官在试图制止斗殴时鼻子骨折。

该警官对房主提起诉讼，指控其邀请这群人到他家观看这场冠军赛的行为构成过失。房主已提出动议，请求驳回诉状。

支持该动议的最佳论点是什么？
options:
A. A police officer is not entitled to a recovery based upon the negligent conduct that created the need for the officer's professional intervention.
警官无权基于造成其需要进行专业干预的过失行为获得赔偿。

B. A rescuer injured while attempting to avert a danger cannot recover damages from the endangered person.
在试图避免危险时受伤的救援者，不能从处于危险中的人那里获得损害赔偿。

C. As a matter of law, the homeowner's conduct was not the proximate cause of the police officer's injury.
从法律上讲，房主的行为并非警官受伤的近因。

D. The homeowner did not owe the police officer a duty to use reasonable care, because the officer was a mere licensee on the homeowner's property.
房主对警官不负有采取合理注意的义务，因为警官在其房产上仅仅是一名被许可人(licensee)。
data.explanation:
Rescue doctrine


General ruleRescuers can recover for injuries sustained while attempting to rescue another if that person's peril was caused by defendant's negligence
Exception
(firefighter's rule)		Professional rescuers cannot recover for injuries attributable to special dangers of their job - eg:
  • firefighter entering burning building
  • police officer arresting suspect
  • paramedic/lifeguard attempting risky rescue
Under the rescue doctrine, persons who negligently endanger themselves or others are liable for injuries sustained by rescuers. But the firefighter's rule is a limitation on the rescue doctrine that applies to all professional rescuers (eg, police officers). This rule bars professional rescuers from recovering for harm that resulted from the special dangers of their jobs - eg, the negligent conduct that created the need for their professional intervention.

Here, the police officer was injured in his efforts to stop the fighting among the homeowner's guests. The officer then sued the homeowner, alleging that he was negligent in inviting the group (who were prone to fighting) to his house to watch the game. But since the officer cannot recover based upon the negligent conduct that created the need for his professional intervention, this is the best argument for dismissing his complaint.

(Choice B) An injured rescuer can recover damages from an endangered person if that person's own negligence created the need for his/her rescue. But the firefighter's rule still bars the police officer's recovery in this instance.

(Choice C) The homeowner's conduct was a proximate cause of the police officer's injury since harm to rescuers is always a foreseeable consequence of negligence.

(Choice D) Police officers are mere licensees when they enter a person's land. But land possessors (eg, the homeowner) owe licensees a duty to use reasonable care in conducting activities (eg, parties) on the land.

Educational objective: The firefighter's rule bars firefighters and other professional rescuers from recovering for harm that resulted from the special dangers of their jobs - eg, the negligent conduct that created the need for their professional intervention.

选项正确率统计：A选项 81%（正确选项），B选项 8%，C选项 7%，D选项 2%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

救援原则 (Rescue doctrine)


一般规则如果他人所处的危险是由被告的过失造成的，那么救援者在试图救援时所受的伤害可以获得赔偿
例外
(消防员规则, firefighter's rule)		专业救援人员不能因其工作固有特殊危险所造成的伤害获得赔偿——例如：
  • 消防员进入燃烧的建筑物
  • 警官逮捕嫌疑人
  • 急救人员/救生员尝试高风险救援
根据救援原则 (rescue doctrine)，因自身过失而使自己或他人陷入危险的人，应对救援者所受的伤害承担责任。但是，消防员规则 (firefighter's rule) 是对救援原则的一项限制，适用于所有专业救援人员（例如警官）。该规则禁止专业救援人员就其工作特殊危险所导致的伤害获得赔偿——例如，造成其需要进行专业干预的过失行为。

在本案中，警官是在试图制止房主客人之间斗殴的过程中受伤的。该警官随后起诉房主，声称其邀请这群（有斗殴倾向的）人到家中观看比赛的行为构成过失。但由于警官不能基于造成其需要进行专业干预的过失行为获得赔偿，这是驳回其诉状的最佳论点。

(选项B) 如果处于危险中的人因其自身过失而需要被救援，受伤的救援者可以从该人处获得损害赔偿。但在本案中，消防员规则 (firefighter's rule) 仍然禁止该警官获得赔偿。

(选项C) 房主的行为是警官受伤的近因，因为对救援者的伤害始终是过失行为的可预见后果。

(选项D) 警官进入他人土地时，仅仅是被许可人 (licensee)。但是，土地占有者（例如，房主）对被许可人负有在土地上进行活动（例如，聚会）时采取合理注意的义务。

教学目的：消防员规则 (firefighter's rule) 禁止消防员和其他专业救援人员就其工作固有特殊危险所造成的伤害获得赔偿——例如，造成其需要进行专业干预的过失行为。

References

62 Am. Jur. 2d Premises Liability § 421 (2019) (explaining that the firefighter's rule prevents professional rescuers from recovering for injuries arising out of the special risks of their professions).

MBE 考点解析

Negligence & The Firefighter's Rule

🔥 核心考点：消防员规则 The Firefighter's Rule

这是一项公共政策规则，旨在限制专业救援人员（如警察、消防员）因工作职责范围内的风险而起诉造成该风险的人。

规则要义：如果被告的过失仅仅是造成了需要专业救援人员介入的紧急情况，那么救援人员不能就该过失造成的伤害获得赔偿。

📊 案情逻辑分析

本案中，房主邀请容易打架的球迷看球，这可能构成过失（Negligence）。这种过失导致了斗殴，从而需要警察（专业救援人员）介入。

警察在履行职责（制止斗殴）时受伤。虽然房主的过失导致了警察必须出警，但根据消防员规则，警察承担了其职业固有的风险，因此不能起诉房主。

✅ 为什么选 A？
正确答案 A

"警官无权基于造成其需要进行专业干预的过失行为获得赔偿。"

这句话是对 Firefighter's Rule 的完美阐述。警察作为专业人员，其工作职责就是处理此类危险。既然他因处理其受雇处理的风险而受伤，法律禁止他向制造该风险的人索赔。

❌ 其他选项为何错误？
选项 B

错误理由：这混淆了救援原则 (Rescue Doctrine)。一般规则是：救援者可以向制造危险的人索赔（"Danger invites rescue"）。消防员规则是这一原则的例外，专门针对专业人员。选项B的表述本身在普通法下通常是不正确的（普通救援者通常能获赔），且未能点出本案的关键点——原告是“专业”人员。

选项 C

错误理由：关于近因 (Proximate Cause)。法律通常认为，过失导致救援者受伤是可预见 (Foreseeable) 的后果。因此，房主的行为是近因。驳回起诉不是因为没有因果关系，而是因为公共政策（消防员规则）禁止索赔。

选项 D

错误理由：关于被许可人 (Licensee)。虽然警察进入私宅通常被视为被许可人，但土地占有者对被许可人仍负有一定义务（如对正在进行的活动采取合理注意）。选项A是“最佳论点”，因为消防员规则是一个绝对的阻却事由 (Absolute Bar)，比争论土地占有者的具体义务标准更有力。

💡 MBE 备考锦囊：

遇到救援者受伤的题目，请立即区分原告身份：
  • 普通路人 (Good Samaritan)：适用 Rescue Doctrine，只要救援行为不过分鲁莽，通常可以向过失方索赔。
  • 专业人员 (Police/Firefighter)：适用 Firefighter's Rule，通常不能因其工作职责内的风险索赔。

questions.question:
A male attendant who worked at a hospital had sexual relations with a severely mentally incompetent patient in her room at the hospital.
In a tort action brought on the patient's behalf against the hospital, will the patient prevail?

choices.a: No, if the male attendant's actions were outside the scope of his employment.
choices.b: No, if the patient initiated the relationship with the male attendant and encouraged his actions.
choices.c: Yes, if the hospital failed to use reasonable care to protect the patient from such conduct.
choices.d: Yes, if the male attendant was an employee of the hospital.

Q83108

A male attendant who worked at a hospital had sexual relations with a severely mentally disabled patient in her room at the hospital.

In a tort action brought on the patient's behalf against the hospital, will the patient prevail?

一名在医院工作的男性护理员，在其医院病房内与一名患有严重精神障碍的女病人发生了性关系。

在代表该病人对医院提起的侵权诉讼中，病人能否胜诉？
options:
A. No, if the male attendant's actions were outside the scope of his employment.
不会，如果该男性护理员的行为超出了其雇佣范围。

B. No, if the patient initiated the relationship with the male attendant and encouraged his actions.
不会，如果是病人主动与该男性护理员建立关系并鼓励其行为。

C. Yes, if the hospital failed to use reasonable care to protect the patient from such conduct.
会，如果医院未能尽到合理注意义务以保护病人免受此类行为的侵害。

D. Yes, if the male attendant was an employee of the hospital.
会，如果该男性护理员是医院的雇员。
data.explanation:
Special relationships

Special relationships imposing duty to protect others


Parent/child
Hospital/patient
Employer/employees
Shopkeeper/business invitees
Common carrier/passengers
Custodian/person in custody
Innkeeper/guests
Mnemonic: Please Help Eliminate Safety Concerns Causing Injuries

A defendant generally has no duty to protect a plaintiff from harm. But when the defendant has a special relationship with the plaintiff (eg, hospitals and their patients), the defendant has a duty to exercise reasonable care to protect the plaintiff from harm arising within the scope of that relationship. A defendant is liable for negligence if it breaches this duty and causes the plaintiff harm.

Here, the hospital had a duty to use reasonable care to protect the patient from harm arising within the scope of the hospital-patient relationship. Since the male attendant had sexual relations with the patient in her hospital room, her harm occurred within the scope of that relationship. Therefore, the patient will prevail in her action against the hospital if it failed to use reasonable care to protect her from the male attendant's conduct.

(Choice B) Consent to another's conduct is a complete bar to recovery for the resulting harm. But a person can only consent if he/she has the capacity to do so - ie, the ability to understand the nature and effect of his/her actions. And since the patient was severely mentally disabled (no capacity), the fact that she initiated the relationship with the male attendant or encouraged his actions would not defeat her claim.

(Choices A & D) Under the doctrine of respondeat superior, an employer is vicariously liable for torts committed by its employees while acting within the scope of employment - ie, while (1) performing assigned work or (2) engaging in conduct subject to the employer's control. But even if the male attendant was not an employee or was acting outside the scope of employment (no vicarious liability), the hospital will still be directly liable for its own negligence.

Educational objective: A hospital owes a duty to exercise reasonable care to protect its patients from harm arising within the scope of the hospital-patient relationship.

选项正确率统计：A选项 20%，B选项 0%，C选项 50%（正确选项），D选项 27%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

特殊关系

施加保护他人义务的特殊关系


P父母/子女 (Parent/child)
H医院/病人 (Hospital/patient)
E雇主/雇员 (Employer/employees)
S店家/商业受邀人 (Shopkeeper/business invitees)
C公共承运人/乘客 (Common carrier/passengers)
C监护人/被监护人 (Custodian/person in custody)
I旅店经营者/客人 (Innkeeper/guests)
助记词 (Mnemonic): Please Help Eliminate Safety Concerns Causing Injuries

通常情况下，被告没有义务保护原告免受伤害。但是，当被告与原告之间存在特殊关系（例如，医院与其病人）时，被告则有义务采取合理注意，以保护原告免受该关系范围内发生的伤害。如果被告违反此义务并对原告造成损害，则应承担过失责任。

在本案中，医院有义务采取合理注意，以保护病人在医患关系范围内免受伤害。由于男性护理员在病人的病房内与其发生性关系，她所受的伤害发生在该关系范围内。因此，如果医院未能采取合理注意以保护她免受该男性护理员的行为侵害，病人在对医院的诉讼中将会胜诉。

（选项B）对他人行为的同意是完全阻却就所致损害进行索赔的理由。但一个人只有在具备同意能力——即理解其行为性质和后果的能力时，才能作出有效同意。由于该病人患有严重精神障碍（无行为能力），因此，即使她主动与男性护理员建立关系或鼓励其行为，这一事实也不会使其索赔不成立。

（选项A和D）根据“雇主替代责任 (respondeat superior)”原则，雇主应对其雇员在雇佣范围内行事时（即（1）履行指派的工作或（2）从事受雇主控制的行为时）所犯下的侵权行为承担替代责任。但即使该男性护理员不是雇员或其行为超出了雇佣范围（无替代责任），医院仍将因其自身的过失而承担直接责任。

教学目标：医院负有采取合理注意的义务，以保护其病人在医患关系范围内免受伤害。

References

  • Restatement (Second) of Torts § 282 (Am. Law Inst. 1979) (definition of negligence).
  • Restatement (Second) of Torts § 314 (Am. Law Inst. 1979) (no duty to act to protect or aid another).
  • Restatement (Second) of Torts § 314A (Am. Law Inst. 1979) (duty to protect or aid based on special relationship).

MBE 考点解析

Torts: Negligence & Special Relationships

本题考察的核心是侵权法中的“特殊关系” (Special Relationships) 以及直接过失 (Direct Negligence) 与替代责任 (Vicarious Liability) 的区别。

⚖️ 核心法律规则

一般规则： 通常情况下，一个人没有义务采取积极行动去保护他人免受第三方（包括犯罪分子）的伤害。

例外 - 特殊关系 (Special Relationships)： 当被告与原告之间存在特殊关系时，被告有义务采取合理注意 (Reasonable Care) 来保护原告免受伤害。

常见的特殊关系包括：

  • 医院与病人 Hospital / Patient
  • 公共承运人与乘客 Common Carrier / Passenger
  • 旅店与客人 Innkeeper / Guest
  • 学校与学生 School / Student
🔍 题目解析：为什么选 C？

直接责任 (Direct Liability)：

在本案中，医院与病人之间存在明确的“特殊关系”。因此，医院负有独立的义务（Duty），即采取合理的措施（如背景调查、监控、监管）来保护病人。

如果医院未能尽到这一义务（例如雇佣了有前科的人员或监管不力），导致病人受到伤害，医院就构成了过失 (Negligence)。

✅ 选项 C 正确：它直接指出了医院因未能尽到“合理注意义务”而承担责任。

🚫 为什么其他选项是错误的？

❌ 选项 A & D：混淆了替代责任 (Vicarious Liability)

这两个选项试图引导你思考“雇主替代责任” Respondeat Superior。

  • 根据该原则，雇主仅对员工在“受雇范围” (Scope of Employment) 内的行为负责。
  • 陷阱： 性侵犯 (Sexual Assault) 通常被视为员工的个人行为（Personal Frolic），是为了个人满足，不属于受雇范围。

如果只依赖替代责任，原告可能会败诉。但本题的关键在于医院自身的过失（直接责任），即使员工的行为超出了受雇范围，医院仍可能因监管不力而负责。

❌ 选项 B：同意 (Consent) 无效

虽然“同意”通常是侵权行为的抗辩理由，但有效的同意需要具备行为能力 (Capacity)。

题目明确指出病人患有“严重精神障碍” (Severely Mentally Disabled)，这意味着她在法律上没有能力理解行为的性质和后果，因此她的“同意”是无效的。

🎓 MBE 考试技巧

在处理涉及员工犯罪或故意侵权（如殴打、性侵）的题目时：

  1. 首先检查替代责任：通常雇主不负责，除非该行为是被雇佣性质所预见的（如保镖打人）。
  2. 关键转折：如果替代责任走不通，立即寻找直接过失 (Direct Negligence)。问自己：雇主在雇佣、培训或监管方面是否有疏忽？
  3. 对于医院、学校、酒店，优先考虑“特殊关系”带来的保护义务。

questions.question:
A security guard, dressed in plain clothes, was working for a discount store when a customer got into a heated argument with a cashier over the store's refund policy. Without identifying himself as a security guard, the security guard suddenly grabbed the customer's arm. The customer attempted to push the security guard away, and the security guard knocked the customer to the floor, causing him injuries.
The customer sued the store for battery on a theory of vicarious liability for the injuries caused by the security guard. The store filed an answer to the customer's complaint, asserting the affirmative defense of contributory negligence. The customer has moved to strike the affirmative defense. Traditional rules of contributory negligence apply.
Should the trial court grant the customer's motion?

choices.a: No, because contributory negligence is an affirmative defense to a cause of action based on vicarious liability.
choices.b: No, because the customer should have known that his argument with the cashier might provoke an action by a security guard.
choices.c: Yes, because contributory negligence is not a defense to battery.
choices.d: Yes, because the customer did not know that he was pushing away someone who was employed as a security guard.

data.questionStem:
Q83811 A security guard, dressed in plain clothes, was working for a discount store when a customer got into a heated argument with a cashier over the store's refund policy. Without identifying himself as a security guard, the security guard suddenly grabbed the customer's arm. The customer attempted to push the security guard away, and the security guard knocked the customer to the floor, causing him injuries.

The customer sued the store for battery on a theory of vicarious liability for the injuries caused by the security guard. The store filed an answer to the customer's complaint, asserting the affirmative defense of contributory negligence. The customer has moved to strike the affirmative defense. Traditional rules of contributory negligence apply.

Should the trial court grant the customer's motion? 一名身着便衣的保安正在一家折扣店工作，当时一名顾客因该店的退款政策与收银员发生了激烈争执。在未表明自己是保安的情况下，该保安突然抓住了顾客的手臂。顾客试图推开保安，保安则将顾客打倒在地，导致其受伤。

顾客以替代责任理论起诉该商店，要求其对保安造成的伤害承担殴击责任。商店对顾客的起诉状提交了答辩状，主张共同过失的积极抗辩。顾客已提出动议，要求排除该积极抗辩。本案适用传统的共同过失规则。

初审法院是否应批准顾客的动议？
options:
A. No, because contributory negligence is an affirmative defense to a cause of action based on vicarious liability.
不应，因为共同过失是对基于替代责任的诉因的积极抗辩。

B. No, because the customer should have known that his argument with the cashier might provoke an action by a security guard.
不应，因为顾客应该知道他与收银员的争执可能会引发保安的行动。

C. Yes, because contributory negligence is not a defense to battery.
应该，因为共同过失不是对殴击的抗辩。

D. Yes, because the customer did not know that he was pushing away someone who was employed as a security guard.
应该，因为顾客不知道他推开的是一名受雇的保安。
data.explanation:
Contributory negligence is an affirmative defense that completely bars the plaintiff's recovery when his/her conduct falls below the standard of care persons should use for their own protection (ie, the plaintiff's own negligence contributed to the harm). However, under the traditional rules of contributory negligence, contributory negligence serves only as a defense to negligence claims—not intentional tort claims like battery.

Since the customer sued the store for battery—not negligence—contributory negligence is not a defense. Therefore, the court should grant the customer's motion to strike that defense.

(Choice A) A principal can only assert contributory negligence as a defense to a negligence cause of action based on a theory of vicarious liability. Here, the customer alleged that the store was vicariously liable for the guard's battery. Because the guard could not assert contributory negligence as a defense to battery, neither can the store.

(Choices B & D) If the store could assert the defense of contributory negligence, then the court would consider whether the customer should have known that a heated argument with the cashier might provoke the guard or did not know that he was pushing away a guard. But since contributory negligence is not a defense to battery, these factual issues do not matter.

Educational objective: Under the traditional rules of contributory negligence, contributory negligence completely bars the plaintiff's recovery when his/her own negligence was a contributing cause of the harm. This affirmative defense only applies to negligence claims.



共同过失 (Contributory negligence) 是一项积极抗辩，当原告的行为低于个人为自我保护应遵循的注意标准时（即原告自身的过失促成了损害的发生），该抗辩将完全阻止原告获得赔偿。然而，根据传统的共同过失规则，共同过失仅能作为对过失 (negligence) 侵权主张的抗辩——而不能作为对如殴击 (battery) 等故意侵权 (intentional tort) 行为主张的抗辩。

由于顾客起诉商店的罪名是殴击——而非过失——共同过失不能作为抗辩。因此，法院应批准顾客排除该抗辩的动议。

(选项A) 委托人 (principal) 只能在基于替代责任理论的过失诉因中主张共同过失作为抗辩。在本案中，顾客声称商店对保安的殴击行为负有替代责任。因为保安不能主张共同过失作为对殴击的抗辩，所以商店也不能。

(选项B和D) 如果商店可以主张共同过失的抗辩，那么法院会考虑顾客是否应该知道与收银员的激烈争执可能会激怒保安，或者他是否知道自己推开的是一名保安。但由于共同过失不是对殴击的抗辩，这些事实问题无关紧要。

教学目的： 根据传统的共同过失规则，当原告自身的过失是造成损害的一个促成原因时，共同过失将完全阻止原告获得赔偿。这项积极抗辩仅适用于过失侵权主张。

References
Fed. R. Civ. P. 12(f) (motion to strike).

Restatement (Second) of Torts § 463 (Am. Law Inst. 1965) (definition of contributory negligence).

Restatement (Second) of Torts § 467 (Am. Law Inst. 1965) (effect of contributory negligence).

MBE 考点解析

Torts: Defenses to Intentional Torts

⚖️ 核心法则 (Black Letter Law)

共同过失 (Contributory Negligence) 仅适用于过失侵权 (Negligence) 案件，绝不适用于故意侵权 (Intentional Torts) 案件。

案情逻辑分析

本题考察的是抗辩事由的适用范围。我们需要理清以下三个步骤：

  1. 确定诉因 (Cause of Action)：
    顾客起诉的是 殴击 (Battery)。这是一个故意侵权 (Intentional Tort)。虽然顾客是基于替代责任 (Vicarious Liability) 起诉商店，但这并没有改变侵权行为本身的性质。
  2. 确定抗辩 (Defense)：
    商店提出的抗辩是 共同过失 (Contributory Negligence)。
  3. 法则匹配：
    法律规定，对于故意侵权行为，被告不能通过指责原告“不小心”来减轻或免除自己的责任。因此，共同过失不是殴击罪的有效抗辩。
为何选 C？
✅ 选项 C 正确

法院应该批准顾客的动议（即驳回商店的抗辩）。
因为 Contributory Negligence is not a defense to Battery.
既然该抗辩在法律上对故意侵权无效，那么无论事实如何，该抗辩都应被排除 (Strike)。
干扰项陷阱
❌ 选项 A (Vicarious Liability)
Vicarious Liability（替代责任）只是让雇主为雇员的行为“买单”。如果雇员（保安）自己不能主张共同过失来对抗殴击指控，那么雇主（商店）也不能。替代责任不会创造出新的抗辩理由。
❌ 选项 B & D (Fact-based arguments)
这两个选项都在讨论事实细节（顾客是否知道后果、是否知道对方是保安）。
考点提示： 如果法律上该抗辩根本不存在（即共同过失不适用于殴击），那么事实细节就完全无关紧要 (Irrelevant)。不要被事实细节带偏。
💡 MBE 考试技巧

当看到被告主张 Contributory Negligence 或 Comparative Negligence 时，第一反应必须是检查原告的诉因 (Cause of Action)：
  • 如果是 Negligence ➡️ 抗辩可能有效。
  • 如果是 Intentional Tort (如 Battery, Assault) ➡️ 抗辩无效。
  • 如果是 Strict Liability ➡️ 传统规则下 Contributory Negligence 通常无效（除非原告由于 Assumption of Risk 自愿承担风险）。

questions.question:
A construction company was digging a trench for a new sewer line in a street in a high-crime neighborhood. During the course of the construction, there had been many thefts of tools and equipment from the construction area. One night, the construction company's employees neglected to place warning lights around the trench. A delivery truck drove into the trench and broke an axle. While the truck driver was looking for help, thieves broke into the truck and stole $350,000 worth of goods.
The delivery company sued the construction company to recover for the $350,000 loss and for the damage to its truck. The construction company has stipulated that it was negligent in failing to place warning lights around the trench and admits liability for damage to the truck, but it denies liability for the loss of the goods.
On cross-motions for summary judgment on the claim for the goods, how should the court rule?

choices.a: Deny both motions, because there is evidence to support a finding that the construction company should have realized that its negligence could create an opportunity for a third party to commit a crime.
choices.b: Grant the construction company's motion, because no one could have foreseen that the failure to place warning lights could result in the loss of a cargo of valuable goods.
choices.c: Grant the construction company's motion, because the criminal acts of third persons were a superseding cause of the loss.
choices.d: Grant the delivery company's motion, because but for the construction company's actions, the goods would not have been stolen.

一家建筑公司正在一个高犯罪率社区的街道上为一条新的下水道管线挖沟。在施工期间，施工区域发生了多起工具和设备被盗事件。一天晚上，该建筑公司的员工疏忽了在壕沟周围放置警示灯。一辆送货卡车驶入壕沟，导致车轴断裂。当卡车司机寻求帮助时，小偷闯入卡车，盗走了价值35万美元的货物。

送货公司起诉建筑公司，要求其赔偿35万美元的货物损失以及卡车的损坏。建筑公司已承认其未在壕沟周围放置警示灯存在过失，并承认对卡车损坏负有赔偿责任，但否认对货物损失负有责任。

对于货物损失的索赔，在双方均提出即决判决动议的情况下，法院应如何裁决？
options:
A. Deny both motions, because there is evidence to support a finding that the construction company should have realized that its negligence could create an opportunity for a third party to commit a crime.
驳回双方的动议，因为有证据支持这样一种认定，即建筑公司本应意识到其过失行为可能为第三方犯罪创造机会。

B. Grant the construction company's motion, because no one could have foreseen that the failure to place warning lights could result in the loss of a cargo of valuable goods.
批准建筑公司的动议，因为没有人能够预见到未放置警示灯会导致一批贵重货物的损失。

C. Grant the construction company's motion, because the criminal acts of third persons were a superseding cause of the loss.
批准建筑公司的动议，因为第三人的犯罪行为是导致损失的介入原因（superseding cause）。

D. Grant the delivery company's motion, because but for the construction company's actions, the goods would not have been stolen.
批准送货公司的动议，因为若无建筑公司的行为，货物便不会被盗。
data.explanation:
Summary judgment should be granted when (1) there is no genuine issue of material fact and (2) no reasonable jury could find for the opposing party - thereby entitling the movant to judgment as a matter of law. Such motions are often brought in negligence claims, which require proof of the following elements: duty, breach, causation, and damages. The causation element consists of two prongs:
  • actual cause - the plaintiff's harm would not have occurred but for the defendant's negligence and
  • proximate cause - the plaintiff's harm was a foreseeable consequence of the defendant's negligence.
The proximate-cause prong cannot be satisfied if there was a superseding cause - ie, an unforeseeable act or force that (1) occurred after the defendant's negligence and (2) contributed to the plaintiff's harm. And though criminal acts of third parties are generally unforeseeable, these acts are not superseding causes if the defendant had reason to know that his/her conduct would increase the risk that such acts would occur.

Here, the construction company admitted liability for the damaged truck but argued that it was not liable for the stolen goods because the theft was a superseding cause. Since the construction site was in a high-crime neighborhood with many prior thefts, it is possible (but not certain) that the construction company should have known that its negligence could create an opportunity for a third party to commit a crime. As a result, there is a genuine issue of material fact that warrants the denial of both motions (Choices B & C).

(Choice D) The goods would not have been stolen from the disabled truck but for the construction company's negligence (actual cause). However, this alone does not justify summary judgment for the delivery company since it must also establish proximate cause.

Educational objective: Criminal acts of third parties are a superseding cause unless the defendant had reason to know that his/her negligence would increase the risk that such acts would occur.



选项正确率统计：A选项 63%（正确选项），B选项 9%，C选项 12%，D选项 14%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

在以下情况下应批准即决判决（Summary judgment）：(1) 不存在重大事实的真实争议，且 (2) 任何合理的陪审团都无法做出有利于对方当事人的裁决——从而使动议申请人有权获得依法作出的判决。此类动议常在过失（negligence）索赔中提出，该索赔要求证明以下要素：义务、违反义务、因果关系（causation）和损害赔偿。因果关系要素包括两个方面：
  • 事实原因（actual cause）——若无（but for）被告的过失行为，原告的损害便不会发生，以及
  • 法律原因（近因）（proximate cause）——原告的损害是被告过失行为的可预见后果（foreseeable consequence）。
如果存在介入原因（superseding cause）——即在被告的过失行为之后发生、并导致原告损害的不可预见（unforeseeable）的行为或力量——则法律原因（近因）这一方面无法满足。而且，尽管第三方的犯罪行为通常是不可预见的，但如果被告有理由知道其行为会增加此类行为发生的风险，则这些行为不构成介入原因。

在本案中，建筑公司承认对受损卡车负有责任，但辩称其对被盗货物不负责任，因为盗窃行为是一个介入原因。由于施工现场位于一个高犯罪率且先前发生过多次盗窃的社区，建筑公司本应知道其过失行为可能为第三方犯罪创造机会，这是可能的（但非确定无疑的）。因此，存在重大事实的真实争议，这成为驳回双方动议的理由（选项B和C）。

（选项D） 若无建筑公司的过失行为（事实原因），货物便不会从失能的卡车上被盗。然而，仅此一点并不足以支持对送货公司作出即决判决，因为它还必须确立法律原因（近因）。

教学目的： 第三方的犯罪行为构成介入原因（superseding cause），除非被告有理由知道其过失行为会增加此类行为发生的风险。

References

Restatement (Second) of Torts § 448 (Am. Law Inst. 1965) (explaining when a criminal act of a third party constitutes a superseding cause in a negligence action).

MBE 考点解析

Negligence & Proximate Cause
正确答案：A

驳回双方的动议（Deny both motions），将案件交给陪审团裁决。

核心考点：近因与介入原因
本题考察的是过失侵权（Negligence）中的近因 (Proximate Cause)，特别是第三方的犯罪行为是否构成切断责任链条的介入原因 (Superseding Cause)。
一般规则：
通常情况下，第三方的犯罪行为（Criminal acts of third parties）被视为不可预见的介入原因，会切断被告的责任。

例外规则（本题考点）：
如果被告的过失行为增加了该犯罪行为发生的风险，或者被告有理由预见（Foreseeable）该犯罪行为可能发生，则该犯罪行为不构成介入原因，被告仍需负责。
案情深度解析

1. 事实认定：
建筑公司承认其未放置警示灯存在过失（Breach of Duty）。卡车掉入沟中是直接后果。争议点在于随后的盗窃。

2. 关键细节：
题目特别强调了施工地点位于“高犯罪率社区” (high-crime neighborhood)，且此前施工区域发生过“多起盗窃” (many thefts)。

3. 法律推理：
由于存在高犯罪率和过往盗窃史，一个理性的陪审团可能会认定：建筑公司应当预见到，如果让一辆卡车在夜间因事故瘫痪在无人看管的壕沟旁，极有可能招致盗窃。因此，盗窃并非完全不可预见。

4. 程序问题（即决判决）：
即决判决（Summary Judgment）仅在“无实质性事实争议”时适用。本案中，“盗窃是否可预见”是一个事实问题，存在争议，应由陪审团（Fact Finder）根据证据来决定，而不是由法官直接裁决。

选项辨析
选项 B 错误： 它断言“没有人能够预见”损失。这是一个过于绝对的事实结论。鉴于高犯罪率的背景，预见性是存在的，不能作为法律问题直接判定被告胜诉。
选项 C 错误： 它直接将盗窃定性为“介入原因”（Superseding Cause）。如前所述，如果犯罪行为是可预见的（Foreseeable），它就只是“并发原因”（Intervening Cause），不会切断被告的责任。
选项 D 错误： 它仅依据“事实原因”（But-for Cause/Actual Cause）——即“若无被告行为，货物不会被盗”。但在过失侵权中，原告必须同时证明“事实原因”和“近因”（Proximate Cause）。仅有事实原因不足以获得即决判决。
🎓 MBE 答题技巧：
当题目涉及即决判决 (Summary Judgment) 时，要注意寻找是否存在“事实争议”。

在过失侵权（Negligence）案件中，“可预见性” (Foreseeability) 通常是一个事实问题（Question of Fact），应留给陪审团解决。除非事实极其清晰，否则法院很少会直接通过即决判决来认定是否存在近因。因此，“驳回双方动议”往往是正确方向。

questions.question:
A real estate developer purchased a large tract of land intending to construct residential housing on it. The developer hired a pool company to build a large in-ground swimming pool on the tract. The contract provided that the pool company would carry out blasting operations that were necessary to create an excavation large enough for the pool. The blasting caused cracks to form in the walls of a man's home in a nearby residential neighborhood.
Will the man prevail on an action for damages against the real estate developer?

choices.a: No, if the pool company used reasonable care in conducting the blasting operations.
choices.b: No, if the real estate developer used reasonable care to hire a competent contractor.
choices.c: Yes, because the blasting that the pool company was hired to perform damaged the man's home.
choices.d: Yes, but only if the real estate developer retained the right to direct and control the pool company's construction of the pool.

一个房地产开发商购买了一大片土地，打算在上面建造住宅。该开发商雇佣了一家泳池公司在该地块上建造一个大型的地下游泳池。合同规定，泳池公司将进行必要的爆破作业，以便为泳池挖掘出足够大的坑洞。爆破导致附近一个住宅区内一男子的房屋墙壁出现裂缝。

该男子对房地产开发商提起的损害赔偿诉讼会胜诉吗？
options:
A. No, if the pool company used reasonable care in conducting the blasting operations.
不会，如果泳池公司在进行爆破作业时尽到了合理的注意义务。

B. No, if the real estate developer used reasonable care to hire a competent contractor.
不会，如果房地产开发商在雇佣有能力的承包商时尽到了合理的注意义务。

C. Yes, because the blasting that the pool company was hired to perform damaged the man's home.
会，因为泳池公司受雇进行的爆破作业损坏了该男子的房屋。

D. Yes, but only if the real estate developer retained the right to direct and control the pool company's construction of the pool.
会，但前提是房地产开发商保留了指导和控制泳池公司建造泳池的权利。
data.explanation:
A principal is generally not vicariously liable for torts committed by its independent contractor. However, vicarious liability will be imposed when the independent contractor's work involves a nondelegable duty - ie, a duty retained by the defendant even when the performance of that duty is assigned to an independent contractor. That type of work includes abnormally dangerous activities - uncommon activities in the community that present a foreseeable and highly significant risk of harm that cannot be mitigated by reasonable care.

Here, the real estate developer hired the pool company (independent contractor) to build an in-ground swimming pool. Although the developer normally would not be vicariously liable for the pool company's torts, the pool company had to carry out blasting operations in a residential area (abnormally dangerous activity) to build the pool. And since that work involved a nondelegable duty, the developer is vicariously liable for damages caused by the blasting (cracks in the man's nearby home).

(Choice A) Strict liability (liability without proof of fault) is imposed for abnormally dangerous activities since the risk of harm cannot be mitigated by reasonable care. And since reasonable care could not have reduced the risk of harm from blasting (abnormally dangerous activity), the man can prevail against the real estate developer.

(Choice B) A principal can be directly liable for his/her own negligence in hiring an incompetent independent contractor or vicariously liable for the independent contractor's torts if they involved a nondelegable duty. Therefore, even if the real estate developer used reasonable care in hiring a competent contractor (no direct liability), the developer is still vicariously liable for the damage caused by the pool company's blasting.

(Choice D) A principal who retains the right to control any part of an independent contractor's work may be liable for failing to use reasonable care when exercising that control. But if the work involves an abnormally dangerous activity (as seen here), the principal will be vicariously liable for the plaintiff's harm (eg, damage to home) - regardless of whether the principal retained the right to control the work.

Educational objective: A principal generally is not vicariously liable for its independent contractor's torts. However, vicarious liability will be imposed when the principal had a nondelegable duty of care - eg, when the contractor's work involved an abnormally dangerous activity.



选项正确率统计：A选项 7%，B选项 6%，C选项 65%（正确选项），D选项 19%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

委托人通常对独立承包商所犯的侵权行为不承担转承责任。然而，当独立承包商的工作涉及不可转委托的义务时——即，即使该义务的履行被指派给独立承包商，被告仍保留该义务——将会被课以转承责任。这类工作包括异常危险活动——即社区中不常见、存在可预见的重大损害风险，并且无法通过合理注意来减轻的活动。

在本案中，房地产开发商雇佣了泳池公司（独立承包商）来建造一个地下游泳池。尽管开发商通常不对泳池公司的侵权行为承担转承责任，但泳池公司为了建造泳池，必须在住宅区进行爆破作业（异常危险活动）。由于该工作涉及不可转委托的义务，开发商对爆破造成的损害（该男子附近房屋的裂缝）负有转承责任。

(选项A) 对于异常危险活动，由于损害风险无法通过合理注意来减轻，因此适用严格责任（无需证明过错的责任）。并且，由于合理注意无法减少爆破（异常危险活动）所带来的损害风险，该男子可以对房地产开发商胜诉。

(选项B) 委托人可能因其自身在雇佣不称职的独立承包商时的过失而承担直接责任，或者如果独立承包商的侵权行为涉及不可转委托的义务，则承担转承责任。因此，即使房地产开发商在雇佣有能力的承包商时尽到了合理注意义务（无直接责任），开发商仍然对泳池公司爆破造成的损害负有转承责任。

(选项D) 保留控制独立承包商工作任何部分权利的委托人，可能因在行使该控制权时未能尽到合理注意义务而承担责任。但是，如果工作涉及异常危险活动（如本案所示），无论委托人是否保留控制工作的权利，委托人都将对原告的损害（例如，房屋损坏）承担转承责任。

教学目的： 委托人通常不对其独立承包商的侵权行为承担转承责任。然而，当委托人负有不可转委托的注意义务时——例如，当承包商的工作涉及异常危险活动时——将会被课以转承责任。

References

  • Restatement (Third) of Torts: Liab. for Physical & Emotional Harm § 57 (Am. Law Inst. 2012) (general rule - no vicarious liability for independent contractors).
  • Restatement (Third) of Torts: Liab. for Physical & Emotional Harm § 58 (Am. Law Inst. 2012) (exception - vicarious liability for independent contractor's abnormally dangerous activities).

MBE 考点解析

Torts: Vicarious Liability
正确答案：C

本题考查的核心是独立承包商的转承责任例外情况。

虽然一般原则是委托人不对独立承包商的侵权行为负责，但本案涉及爆破（Blasting），属于异常危险活动（Abnormally Dangerous Activity），因此开发商必须承担责任。

法律规则详解
一般规则 (General Rule)
委托人通常不对独立承包商 (Independent Contractor) 的侵权行为承担转承责任 (Vicarious Liability)。
关键例外 (The Exception)
当工作涉及不可转委托的义务 (Non-delegable Duty) 时，委托人仍需负责。最典型的不可转委托义务就是从事异常危险活动 (Abnormally Dangerous Activities)。

逻辑推演：

  1. 爆破 = 严格责任： 爆破是教科书级的“异常危险活动”。从事此类活动的一方承担严格责任 (Strict Liability)，即无论是否尽到合理注意义务，只要造成损害就要赔偿。
  2. 责任不可转移： 出于公共政策考量，法律禁止委托人将这种高风险活动的责任通过雇佣承包商“甩锅”。
  3. 结论： 即使开发商雇佣了专业的泳池公司，且开发商自己没有过失，开发商仍需对爆破造成的损害承担转承责任。
选项辨析
选项 A 错误 理由： 提到“合理注意 (Reasonable Care)”。对于异常危险活动适用严格责任，合理注意不是抗辩理由。
选项 B 错误 理由： 提到“谨慎雇佣 (Negligent Hiring)”。虽然谨慎雇佣可以免除开发商的直接过失责任，但无法免除因异常危险活动产生的转承责任。
选项 D 错误 理由： 提到“控制权 (Right to Control)”。这是区分雇员与独立承包商的标准。但在异常危险活动面前，无论是否保留控制权，委托人都必须负责。
💡
MBE 考试技巧：
看到 Blasting (爆破)、Fumigation (熏蒸) 或 Wild Animals (野生动物)，请立即联想两个概念：
1. Strict Liability (严格责任 - 无论多小心都要赔)
2. Non-delegable Duty (不可转委托 - 即使外包也要赔)

questions.question:
A man was admitted to a hospital after complaining of persistent severe headaches. While he was there, hospital staff failed to diagnose his condition, and he was discharged. Two days later, the man died of a massive brain hemorrhage due to a congenital defect in an artery.
The man's wife has brought a wrongful death action against the hospital. The wife offers expert testimony that the man would have had a "reasonable chance" (not greater than 50%) of surviving the hemorrhage if he had been given appropriate medical care at the hospital.
In what type of jurisdiction would the wife's suit most likely be successful?

choices.a: A jurisdiction that allows recovery based on strict liability.
choices.b: A jurisdiction that allows recovery for the loss of the chance of survival.
choices.c: A jurisdiction that applies traditional common law rules concerning burden of proof.
choices.d: A jurisdiction that recognizes loss of spousal consortium.

data.questionStem:
Q83119

A man was admitted to a hospital after complaining of persistent severe headaches. While he was there, hospital staff failed to diagnose his condition, and he was discharged. Two days later, the man died of a massive brain hemorrhage due to a congenital defect in an artery.

The man's wife has brought a wrongful death action against the hospital. The wife offers expert testimony that the man would have had a "reasonable chance" (not greater than 50%) of surviving the hemorrhage if he had been given appropriate medical care at the hospital.

In what type of jurisdiction would the wife's suit most likely be successful?

一名男子因持续性剧烈头痛入院。在院期间，医院工作人员未能诊断出其病情，致其出院。两天后，该男子因动脉先天性缺陷导致大面积脑出血死亡。

该男子的妻子对医院提起了非正常死亡诉讼。妻子提供了专家证言，证明如果该男子在医院得到适当的医疗护理，他将有“合理的机会”（不高于50%）在出血后存活。

在哪种类型的司法管辖区，该妻子的诉讼最有可能成功？
options:
A. A jurisdiction that allows recovery based on strict liability.
一个允许基于严格责任进行索赔的司法管辖区。

B. A jurisdiction that allows recovery for the loss of the chance of survival.
一个允许就生存机会的丧失进行索赔的司法管辖区。

C. A jurisdiction that applies traditional common law rules concerning burden of proof.
一个适用关于举证责任的传统普通法规则的司法管辖区。

D. A jurisdiction that recognizes loss of spousal consortium.
一个承认配偶共同生活权丧失的司法管辖区。
data.explanation:
Actual causation (in wrongful death claims based on medical malpractice)


Traditional common law ruleDecedent probably would have survived (ie, greater than 50% chance) but for defendant's malpractice
Modern rule (loss-of-chance doctrine)Decedent's chance of survival was reduced by defendant's malpractice (eg, 45% chance reduced to 20%)
Wrongful death statutes allow a decedent's spouse, next of kin, or personal representative to sue a defendant for wrongfully causing the decedent's death. These lawsuits are often based on medical malpractice (eg, failure to diagnose - as seen here), which requires the plaintiff to prove actual causation by a preponderance of the evidence. Traditionally, this standard is met if it is more likely than not (ie, greater than 50% chance ) that the decedent would have survived but for the defendant's malpractice.

Here, the wife offered expert testimony that the man had a reasonable chance - not greater than 50 percent - of survival had he received appropriate medical care. As a result, her suit would not be successful in a jurisdiction that applies traditional common law rules concerning burden of proof (Choice C). However, most jurisdictions recognize the loss-of-chance doctrine, which allows the plaintiff to recover if the malpractice caused any loss of the chance of survival. Therefore, the wife's suit is most likely to be successful in such a jurisdiction.

(Choice A) Strict liability subjects a defendant to liability regardless of the defendant's level of fault. But it would still require proof of actual causation, which cannot be proved here unless this jurisdiction allows recovery for loss of chance.

(Choice D) In a wrongful death action, most jurisdictions allow recovery for loss of spousal consortium (ie, spousal support, companionship, and sexual relations). But even if this jurisdiction does so, the wife cannot establish actual causation or succeed in her claim unless this is a loss-of- chance jurisdiction.

Educational objective: The loss-of-chance doctrine allows a plaintiff to recover in a wrongful death action based on medical malpractice if the defendant's malpractice caused any reduction in the decedent's chance of survival.

选项正确率统计：A选项 11%，B选项 71%（正确选项），C选项 3%，D选项 12%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

事实因果关系（在基于医疗事故的非正常死亡索赔中）


传统普通法规则若非被告的医疗事故，死者很可能（即，大于50%的机会）会存活
现代规则（loss-of-chance doctrine）死者的生存机会因被告的医疗事故而降低（例如，从45%的机会降低到20%）
非正常死亡法规允许死者的配偶、近亲或遗产代理人因被告不法行为导致死者死亡而对其提起诉讼。这些诉讼通常基于医疗事故（例如，本案中的未能诊断），这要求原告以“证据优势”原则证明事实因果关系。传统上，如果死者若非被告的医疗事故便很有可能（即大于50%的机会）存活，则满足此标准。

在本案中，妻子提供的专家证言称，如果该男子得到适当的医疗护理，他有合理的生存机会——但不超过50%。因此，在一个适用关于举证责任的传统普通法规则的司法管辖区，她的诉讼不会成功（选项C）。然而，大多数司法管辖区承认loss-of-chance doctrine（生存机会丧失理论），该理论允许在医疗事故导致生存机会任何丧失的情况下，原告获得赔偿。因此，该妻子的诉讼最有可能在这样的司法管辖区获得成功。

（选项A）严格责任使被告无论其过错程度如何都要承担责任。但它仍然需要证明事实因果关系，除非该司法管辖区允许就生存机会的丧失进行索赔，否则在本案中无法证明事实因果关系。

（选项D）在非正常死亡诉讼中，大多数司法管辖区允许就配偶共同生活权的丧失（即配偶间的扶持、陪伴和性关系）进行索赔。但即使该司法管辖区承认这一点，除非这是一个适用生存机会丧失理论的司法管辖区，否则妻子无法确立事实因果关系，也无法在索赔中获胜。

教学目的： loss-of-chance doctrine（生存机会丧失理论）允许原告在基于医疗事故的非正常死亡诉讼中，如果被告的医疗事故导致死者生存机会的任何降低，即可获得赔偿。

References

Restatement (Third) of Torts: Liab. for Physical & Emotional Harm, § 26 cmt. n (Am. Law Inst. 2010) (explaining that many courts recognize a lost chance for cure of a medical condition as a legally cognizable harm).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

Torts / Negligence / Causation
核心考点：事实因果关系 (Actual Causation)

本题考察的是医疗事故 (Medical Malpractice) 中的因果关系证明标准，特别是当患者存活几率本来就很低（低于50%）时，如何认定责任。

✅ 正确答案：选项 B

承认“生存机会丧失”理论的司法管辖区 (Loss of Chance Doctrine)。

在传统的过失侵权 (Negligence) 诉讼中，原告必须证明被告的行为是导致伤害的“事实原因” (Actual Cause)。通常采用“若非”测试 (But-for Test)，即原告需证明：若非被告的过失，死者有超过 50% 的可能性会存活。

在本题中，专家证言指出死者的存活几率不超过 50%。这意味着在传统规则下，原告无法满足举证责任（无法证明被告的过失是导致死亡的决定性原因）。

因此，原告只有在承认 Loss of Chance Doctrine 的管辖区才能胜诉。该理论将“生存机会的减少”本身视为一种损害，允许原告即使在存活几率低于 50% 的情况下，也能就这部分丧失的机会获得赔偿。

传统规则 vs. 现代规则
规则类型 证明标准 本案结果 (≤50%几率)
传统普通法 (Traditional Common Law) 必须证明若无过失，存活几率 > 50% (More likely than not) ❌ 败诉 (选项C)
生存机会丧失 (Loss of Chance) 只要证明过失导致存活几率降低 (哪怕从 40% 降至 0%) ✅ 胜诉 (选项B)
为什么其他选项是错误的？
选项 A (Strict Liability)
医疗事故通常基于过失 (Negligence)，而非严格责任 (Strict Liability)。即使适用严格责任，原告仍需证明因果关系 (Causation)，而在本案中，没有 Loss of Chance 理论的支持，因果关系无法成立。
选项 C (Traditional Rules)
如上表所示，传统规则要求“优势证据” (Preponderance of the Evidence)，即 >50% 的可能性。本案中存活几率 ≤50%，因此在传统规则下无法建立因果关系。
选项 D (Loss of Consortium)
丧失配偶共同生活权 (Loss of Consortium) 是一种损害赔偿 (Damages) 的类型，而不是确立责任 (Liability) 的依据。如果无法证明因果关系（即无法证明被告对死亡负责），那么无论该地是否允许此类赔偿，原告都无法胜诉。
💡 MBE 考试技巧

当你看到题目中明确提到存活几率低于 50% (not greater than 50%) 的医疗事故案例时，出题人几乎总是在考察 Loss of Chance 理论。

关键逻辑链：
几率 ≤ 50% + 传统规则 = 败诉
几率 ≤ 50% + Loss of Chance = 胜诉

© MBE Torts Review | 仅供学习参考

questions.question:
While visiting at his son's home, a grandfather tripped on a toy left on the floor by his four-year-old grandson. The grandfather fell and was severely injured. The grandfather regularly visited his son's home and was aware that the grandson routinely left toys scattered about the house. The son had never warned the grandfather to look out for toys.
The grandfather brought an action against his son to recover for his injuries. At trial, after the close of evidence, both the grandfather and the son have moved for judgment as a matter of law as to liability. The jurisdiction has abolished intra-family immunity and applies the traditional rules of landowner liability.
What action should the court take?

choices.a: Deny both motions and submit the case to the jury based on negligence.
choices.b: Deny both motions and submit the case to the jury based on strict liability.
choices.c: Grant the grandfather's motion, because the son is liable as a matter of law for failing to warn about the risk of toys being left on the floor.
choices.d: Grant the son's motion, because the son had no duty to warn that the grandson might leave toys on the floor.

data.questionStem:
Q83830 While visiting at his son's home, a grandfather tripped on a toy left on the floor by his four-year-old grandson. The grandfather fell and was severely injured. The grandfather regularly visited his son's home and was aware that the grandson routinely left toys scattered about the house. The son had never warned the grandfather to look out for toys.

The grandfather brought an action against his son to recover for his injuries. At trial, after the close of evidence, both the grandfather and the son have moved for judgment as a matter of law as to liability. The jurisdiction has abolished intra-family immunity and applies the traditional rules of landowner liability.

What action should the court take? 一位祖父在探望儿子家时，被他四岁的孙子留在地板上的一个玩具绊倒。祖父摔倒并受了重伤。这位祖父定期探望儿子家，并且知道孙子经常把玩具乱扔在房子里。儿子从未警告过祖父要注意玩具。

祖父对儿子提起诉讼，要求赔偿其所受的伤害。在审判中，证据出示结束后，祖父和儿子都就责任问题提出了依法判决的动议。该司法管辖区已废除家庭内部豁免权，并适用传统的土地所有者责任规则。

法院应采取什么行动？
options:
A. Deny both motions and submit the case to the jury based on negligence.
驳回双方的动议，并基于过失将案件提交给陪审团。

B. Deny both motions and submit the case to the jury based on strict liability.
驳回双方的动议，并基于严格责任将案件提交给陪审团。

C. Grant the grandfather's motion, because the son is liable as a matter of law for failing to warn about the risk of toys being left on the floor.
批准祖父的动议，因为根据法律，儿子因未就地板上留有玩具的风险发出警告而应承担责任。

D. Grant the son's motion, because the son had no duty to warn that the grandson might leave toys on the floor.
批准儿子的动议，因为儿子没有义务警告孙子可能会在地板上留下玩具。
data.explanation:
After the parties have presented their evidence to the jury, any party may move for judgment as a matter of law (JMOL). This motion asks the judge to bypass the jury and render a decision in favor of the moving party because no reasonable jury could find in favor of the opposing party. Therefore, a judge should grant a defendant's motion for JMOL if there is legally insufficient evidence to support any element of the plaintiff's claim.

In a negligence claim, the plaintiff must first prove that the defendant owed a duty to the plaintiff. When the defendant is a land possessor, the duty owed to the plaintiff under the traditional rules of landowner liability depends on the plaintiff's status on the land. Many land entrants are licensees—ie, persons who enter another's land with permission (eg, social guests). And a land possessor has a duty to warn licensees about latent (ie, hidden) dangers of which the land possessor is, or should be, aware.

Here, the grandfather (plaintiff) was injured when he tripped on his grandson's toy. The grandfather was a licensee because he was visiting his son's (defendant's) home at the time. But since the grandfather already knew that his grandson routinely left toys scattered about the house, the son had no duty to warn the grandfather that toys might be on the floor. And since the grandfather cannot establish this element of negligence, the court should grant the son's motion (and deny the grandfather's motion) for JMOL (Choices A & C).

(Choice B) Strict liability (ie, liability regardless of fault) is appropriate only in limited situations—none of which apply here.

Educational objective: A land possessor traditionally owes licensees (eg, social guests) a duty to warn about latent dangers of which the land possessor is, or should be, aware.



在各方当事人向陪审团出示证据后，任何一方都可以提出依法判决 (judgment as a matter of law, JMOL) 的动议。该动议请求法官绕过陪审团，直接作出有利于动议方的裁决，因为任何理性的陪审团都不可能作出有利于对方的裁决。因此，如果证据在法律上不足以支持原告主张的任何要素，法官应批准被告的JMOL动议。

在过失索赔中，原告必须首先证明被告对原告负有义务。当被告是土地占有者时，根据传统的土地所有者责任规则，其对原告所负的义务取决于原告在土地上的身份。许多进入土地者是持证人（licensees）——即经允许进入他人土地的人（例如，社交访客）。土地占有者有义务就其已经意识到或应该意识到的潜在（即隐藏的）危险警告持证人。

在本案中，祖父（原告）因被孙子的玩具绊倒而受伤。祖父是持证人，因为他当时正在探望儿子（被告）的家。但由于祖父已经知道他的孙子经常把玩具乱扔在房子里，因此儿子没有义务警告祖父地板上可能有玩具。并且由于祖父无法证实这一过失要素，法院应批准儿子的JMOL动议（并驳回祖父的动议）（选项 A 和 C）。

(选项 B) 严格责任（即无论有无过错均需承担的责任）仅适用于有限情况——本案不适用其中任何一种情况。

教学目标： 土地占有者传统上对持证人（例如，社交访客）负有义务，就其已经意识到或应该意识到的潜在危险发出警告。

References

Restatement (Second) of Torts § 342 (Am. Law Inst. 1965) (duty to licensees).

Fed. R. Civ. P. 50(a) (judgment as a matter of law).

MBE 考题解析

Torts: Premises Liability

侵权法 土地所有者责任
核心考点：原告的身份

在传统的土地所有者责任规则下，被告对原告的义务取决于原告进入土地的身份。本案中：

👴 祖父 (Grandfather) = 社交访客 (Social Guest)

在法律上，社交访客被归类为 持证人/许可进入者 (Licensee)，而不是受邀人 (Invitee)。

注：Invitee 通常指为了商业利益进入土地的人（如超市顾客）。

法律规则：对持证人的义务

一般规则：土地占有者有义务就已知的、潜在的（隐藏的）危险向持证人发出警告。

Duty to Warn: Known, latent dangers.

⚠️ 关键例外 (The Exception)：

如果危险是显而易见的 (Obvious)，或者原告已经知道 (Already Aware) 该危险，则被告没有义务 (No Duty) 发出警告。

案情分析逻辑链
1
确定身份：祖父是 Licensee。
2
确定义务：儿子通常有义务警告隐藏的危险。
3
关键事实：题目明确指出 "The grandfather... was aware that the grandson routinely left toys scattered"（祖父知道孙子经常乱扔玩具）。
4
结论：因为祖父已经知晓这一风险，儿子没有义务 (No Duty) 再次警告。
5
程序结果：过失侵权 (Negligence) 的首要要素是 "Duty"。既然没有 Duty，原告的案件在法律上不成立。
为什么选 D？

JMOL (Judgment as a Matter of Law) 是指“依法判决”。当一方无法证明其诉讼请求的必要要素（本案中为“义务 Duty”）时，法官应直接判决，无需陪审团介入。

✅ 正确答案：D
批准儿子的动议，因为儿子没有义务警告。
其他选项为何错误？
  • 选项 A (交给陪审团)： 只有在事实有争议时才交给陪审团。这里关于“祖父知情”的事实是确定的，因此法律上不存在义务，法官应直接判决。
  • 选项 B (严格责任 Strict Liability)： 严格责任通常仅适用于极度危险的活动（如爆破、饲养野生动物）。玩具绊倒不属于此列。
  • 选项 C (批准祖父动议)： 祖父败诉，因为他无法证明儿子对他负有警告义务。
MBE Torts Exam Tip: Always check the plaintiff's knowledge!
